committee.sub: Morning brief · Monday 21 September 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend last 7 days was $152.67 against $141.86 prior with 24 clicks and 0 conversions, so cost per click sits at $6.36 with nothing to show for it yet. Post restart clicks since 8 Sept are 45 of the 150 stop loss trigger, so the campaign stays on.

Impressions nearly doubled from 430 to 888 but CTR fell from 5.3% to 2.7%, so the extra volume is not converting to clicks at the old rate. Budget lost (20.2%) is still well under rank lost (74.3%), so the budget conversation has not opened.

Sessions last 7 days rose to 61 from 38 but calculator.usedLast7 is still 0, meaning the extra visits to the homepage (35 sessions) and /ai-automation-agency.html (20 sessions) are not reaching the ungated tool.

AI Assistant sessions moved from 0 to 2 last 7 days, all from chatgpt.com, worth noting given this undercounts real AI referral traffic. LinkedIn stayed at 0 despite Chris posting, which points to untagged links rather than no activity. Organic Search is still the only clean unpaid signal and it is tiny at 9 sessions.

actions.text: Logo and image assets plus keyword matched RSA headlines for the serving ad groups are still outstanding, get these built.
The homepage form still fires kontrolTrackLead before the Formspree verdict, fix it to confirm-then-count so lead counting is accurate.
RSA description D1 still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week, update the copy to match current site stats.
